The only src/lib files are gitignore, gridToRgba, palette, phaserPin, spriteSheet, trackedNodeModules and utils. A grep of all local branch heads also finds none of these symbols. Step 2's file imports runGenerateArt and Step 3 points at scripts/generateArt.ts, so both depend on the missing Step 1 piece and were not written. Also missing: worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json (the target of Step 2's paths) and ui/cursors/hand.png (the expected output; only pointer.svg exists). units.title: Verify: encodePng determinism and readPngSize unit tests

tests.name: tests/pngEncode.test.ts > encodePng determinism
tests.title: encodes the same 4x3 image to byte-identical PNG output on repeated calls
tests.scenario: Given a 4x3 RgbaImage built from indices 0..11, When encodePng is called twice, Then both outputs are byte-for-byte equal.
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/pngEncode.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/pngEncode.test.ts > readPngSize > reads width and height from the IHDR chunk
tests.title: reads width and height from the IHDR chunk of an encoded PNG
tests.scenario: Given a 4x3 encoded PNG, When readPngSize is called, Then it returns {width:4,height:3}.
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/pngEncode.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/pngEncode.test.ts > readPngSize > throws "not a png"
tests.title: throws "not a png" when the bytes do not start with the PNG signature
tests.scenario: Given 30 zero bytes (no PNG signature), When readPngSize is called, Then it throws 'not a png'.
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/pngEncode.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/pngEncode.test.ts > chunk layout > contains only IHDR, IDAT and IEND chunks in that order
tests.title: contains only IHDR, IDAT and IEND chunks in that order
tests.scenario: Given an encoded 4x3 PNG, When its chunks are walked from byte 8, Then the chunk types are exactly ['IHDR', 'IDAT', 'IEND'].
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/pngEncode.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: encodePng is deterministic
tests.title: encodePng produces byte-identical output for the same 4x3 image
tests.scenario: Given a 4x3 RgbaImage built from indices 0..11, When encodePng is called twice, Then both outputs are byte-for-byte equal
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/pngEncode.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: readPngSize reads IHDR
tests.title: readPngSize returns the width and height of an encoded PNG
tests.scenario: Given a 4x3 encoded PNG, When readPngSize is called, Then it returns {width:4,height:3}
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/pngEncode.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: readPngSize rejects non-PNG bytes
tests.title: readPngSize throws 'not a png' when the signature is missing
tests.scenario: Given 30 zero bytes, When readPngSize is called, Then it throws 'not a png'
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/pngEncode.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: only IHDR IDAT IEND chunks
tests.title: encoded PNG contains only IHDR, IDAT and IEND chunks in order
tests.scenario: Given an encoded 4x3 PNG, When chunks are walked from byte 8, Then the types equal ['IHDR','IDAT','IEND']
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/pngEncode.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: generateAssets and mergeManifest unit tests

tests.name: tests/generateAssets.test.ts > generateAssets > when a source has several frames > describes a spritesheet entry whose PNG header matches the packed strip
tests.title: describes a spritesheet entry whose PNG header matches the packed strip
tests.scenario: Given four 32x48 frames of palette index 1, when generateAssets runs, then the entry is a spritesheet of 128x48 with frames {32,48,4}, passes assetSchema, and the PNG header reads 128x48
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: tests/generateAssets.test.ts > generateAssets > when a source has a single frame > describes an image entry without frame metadata
tests.title: describes an image entry without frame metadata
tests.scenario: Given a one-frame 16x16 source, when generateAssets runs, then the entry type is 'image', frames is undefined, and dimensions are 16x16
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: tests/generateAssets.test.ts > generateAssets > when a grid contains a palette index out of range > throws an out-of-range error
tests.title: throws an out-of-range error
tests.scenario: Given a grid containing palette index 999, when generateAssets runs, then it throws an error matching /out of range/
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: tests/generateAssets.test.ts > generateAssets > when the shipped art sources are inspected > has unique ids across ART_SOURCES
tests.title: has unique ids across ART_SOURCES
tests.scenario: Given the shipped ART_SOURCES, when their ids are collected, then the set size equals the list length
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: tests/generateAssets.test.ts > mergeManifest > when an incoming entry matches an existing id > replaces that entry in place and keeps the other entries deep-equal
tests.title: replaces that entry in place and keeps the other entries deep-equal
tests.scenario: Given manifest assets [a,b,c] and an incoming entry with id b changed, when mergeManifest runs, then the order is [a,b',c], a and c deep-equal their originals, and version is kept
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: tests/generateAssets.test.ts > mergeManifest > when an incoming entry has an unknown id > appends that entry after the existing assets
tests.title: appends that entry after the existing assets
tests.scenario: Given manifest assets [a,b] and an incoming entry with id z, when mergeManifest runs, then the order is [a,b,z]
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: sheet entry and PNG header match
tests.title: describes a spritesheet entry whose PNG header matches the packed strip
tests.scenario: Given four 32x48 frames of index 1, when generateAssets runs, then the entry is a spritesheet 128x48 with frames {32,48,4}, passes assetSchema, and the PNG header reads 128x48
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts -t "describes a spritesheet entry"

tests.name: single frame is image
tests.title: describes an image entry without frame metadata
tests.scenario: Given a one-frame 16x16 source, when generateAssets runs, then the entry type is 'image', has no frames, and has dimensions 16x16
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts -t "describes an image entry"

tests.name: bad index throws
tests.title: throws an out-of-range error
tests.scenario: Given a grid containing palette index 999, when generateAssets runs, then it throws an error matching /out of range/
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts -t "throws an out-of-range error"

tests.name: ART_SOURCES ids unique
tests.title: has unique ids across ART_SOURCES
tests.scenario: Given the shipped ART_SOURCES, when their ids are collected, then the set size equals the list length
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts -t "has unique ids across ART_SOURCES"

tests.name: mergeManifest replaces by id
tests.title: replaces that entry in place and keeps the other entries deep-equal
tests.scenario: Given manifest assets [a,b,c] and an entry with id b changed, when mergeManifest runs, then the order is [a,b',c] and a and c are deep-equal to the originals
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts -t "replaces that entry in place"

tests.name: mergeManifest appends unknown id
tests.title: appends that entry after the existing assets
tests.scenario: Given manifest assets [a,b] and an entry with an unknown id z, when mergeManifest runs, then z is appended last
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateAssets.test.ts -t "appends that entry after the existing assets"
